w10_P4_000380: The figure a print-shop manager wants, in kN, is the combined net drive of 7 identical presses, each press's net drive expressed in kN. A press's net drive is the combined push on its 3 identical carriages minus 23 N supplied by a return spring. Each carriage has a mass of 24 kg and a bed 1.4 m wide, and the push on each is the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0. What combined net drive, in kN, does the manager report?
w10_P4_000390: A test sled of mass 19000 grams is launched at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 4 and 15. Its energy of motion at launch, less 28 J absorbed by the launch cradle, is expressed in kJ as the net launch energy. There are 7 identical launches in a session. What is the total net launch energy for the session, in kJ?
w10_P4_000392: A projectile of mass 33 kg is fired along a range 250 m long at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 4 and 19. Its energy of motion at the muzzle, less 14 J lost to barrel friction, is the net energy per shot. A salvo consists of 6 identical shots, and 5 identical salvos are fired. What total net energy, in J, is delivered by the 5 salvos?
w10_P4_000395: A warehouse robot of mass 30 kg moves along an aisle 60 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the largest whole number that divides both 49 and 180 exactly. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 19 kJ of stored battery energy is added to give one robot's energy budget. An aisle holds 12 identical robots, and the warehouse has 4 identical aisles. What is the total energy budget, in kJ, of all the robots?
w10_P4_000396: The number a shipyard wants, in N, is the grand total thrust across 7 identical docks, each dock running 4 identical cranes, each crane driving 2 identical trolleys, every trolley receiving the same thrust. Each trolley has a mass of 195 kg and a wheelbase of 2.2 m. The thrust on each trolley is the force producing its acceleration, and that acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 5x between x = 3 and x = 4. What grand total thrust, in N, does the shipyard report?
w10_P4_000398: A pneumatic launcher on a factory floor fires test carts of mass 29 kg along a rail 6 m long. Each cart's acceleration in m/s^2 is found by taking the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 12x + 32 = 0, multiplying by 8, and adding 16. The launcher fires 8 identical carts at once, each with the force producing that acceleration. What total force, in N, does the launcher exert?
w10_P4_000399: A container terminal accelerates trolleys of mass 177000 grams along rails 90 m long. Each trolley's acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 15x + 56 = 0, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. A rail carries 5 identical trolleys, a berth has 12 identical rails, and the terminal has 5 identical berths. What total force, in kN, is exerted on all the trolleys?
w10_P4_000400: A test drone of mass 26000 grams and rotor span 1.1 m flies at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 4 and 15, reduced by 13. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A squadron is 10 identical drones, and the fleet has 10 identical squadrons. What is the total energy of motion of the fleet, in kJ?
w10_P4_000402: A sled of mass 37000 grams runs on a track 20 m long at a speed in m/s equal to 5 times the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. Three identical sleds run at once. What is the combined energy of motion of the 3 sleds, in kJ?
w10_P4_000403: A scale rally-car model of mass 41 kg is timed on a straight. Its speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 6x between x = 1 and x = 3. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ. A test session is 9 identical runs; the team adds 18 kJ for the energy in the starter battery and subtracts 6 kJ absorbed by the finish-line barrier. What session figure, in kJ, does the team record?
w10_P4_000404: The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is the net energy of a batch: the combined energy of motion of 11 identical pucks, less 7 J absorbed by the catch pad, expressed in kJ. Each puck has a mass of 9 kg. The pucks' speed in m/s is set equal to the acceleration at t = 1 s of a cart whose position in metres is s(t) = 4t^3 - 1t^2 with t in seconds. What net batch energy, in kJ, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000407: A luggage carousel drives trays of mass 94000 grams. Each tray's acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 302 and 275 exactly. A segment drives 4 identical trays, each with the force producing that acceleration, and the segment's frame adds 30 N of guide friction to the combined push. The carousel has 10 identical segments. Express the total load on all 10 segments in kN.
w10_P4_000411: A hospital supply cart of mass 109000 grams runs along a level corridor rail, and its position in metres after t seconds is s(t) = 1t^3 + 2t^2. The tow cable must transmit the force producing the cart's acceleration at t = 1 s plus 1 N of pulley friction, and this cable load is expressed in kN. The cable's anchor also carries 12 kN of static structure load in addition to the cable load. What total load, in kN, does the anchor carry?
w10_P4_000412: A 4000 gram puck is launched across a lab bench at a speed in m/s equal to the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 18 = 0. Its energy of motion at launch, less 18 J absorbed by the launch cradle, is expressed in kJ as the net energy per launch. There are 7 identical launches. What total net energy, in kJ, do the 7 launches deliver?
w10_P4_000414: The number a logistics hub wants, in J, is the grand total over 10 identical shifts, each shift covering 4 identical lines, each line running 11 identical carts, every cart contributing the same energy figure. A cart's energy figure is its energy of motion plus 25 J stored in its brake spring. Each cart has a mass of 33000 grams. Each cart's speed in m/s is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 8 = 0. What grand total, in J, does the hub report?
w10_P4_000424: A sled of mass 64000 grams is accelerated along a level rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 8 times the sum of 5 and 1, reduced by 27. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a booster spring, which contributes 24 N, and the rest comes through the tow cable; the cable's contribution is expressed in kN. The cable's load cell has a zero offset of 2 kN, so its reading is the cable contribution minus 2 kN (a negative reading is possible). What does the load cell read, in kN?
w10_P4_000426: A bowling-alley test rig rolls balls of mass 10 kg down a lane 18 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 30 = 0. A frame holds 9 identical balls; the combined energy of motion of a frame plus 16 J stored in the pin-setter spring is the frame's energy figure. A game is 3 identical frames, and the rig adds 25 J for its ball-return motor to the game total. What game total, in J, does the rig record?
w10_P4_000429: A robotic welder carriage of mass 38000 grams travels along a level gantry 12 m long, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 3t^3 + 0t^2. The gantry mount carries the force producing the carriage's acceleration at t = 1 s, expressed in kN. To that the mount adds 10 kN of clamping load, then a counterweight relieves 18 kN, and finally a hydraulic preload adds 22 kN. What net load, in kN, does the gantry mount carry?
w10_P4_000435: A catapult test sled of mass 30000 grams runs on a rail 15 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 4 times the sum of 5 and 12, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. The rail anchor carries that force plus 30 kN of static preload, plus 11 kN from the tensioning winch, plus 9 kN from the arrestor cable. What total load, in kN, does the anchor carry?
w10_P4_000437: The figure a drone-range manager wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is the grand energy balance: 8 identical days, each day being 5 identical flights, each flight's balance being the drone's energy of motion expressed in kJ minus 8 kJ drawn from its battery. The drone has a mass of 8 kg and a wingspan of 1.5 m. Its speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 2x between x = 0 and x = 3. What grand energy balance, in kJ, does the manager record?
w10_P4_000440: A test kart of mass 33 kg runs on a circuit 300 m long. Its speed in m/s is found by taking the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0, subtracting 12, and then adding 24. The kart's energy of motion at that speed is expressed in kJ, and the 16 kJ drawn from its battery to reach that speed is subtracted to give the energy balance (negative meaning a net loss). What is the energy balance, in kJ?
w10_P4_000442: The number a test-track engineer wants, in kJ, is the energy of motion of a 44000 gram sled at its run speed. The run speed in m/s is 6 times a base figure. The base figure is obtained by taking the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 7x between x = 0 and x = 1, adding 15, and then subtracting 6. What energy of motion, in kJ, does the engineer record?
w10_P4_000447: A freight dolly of mass 140 kg and length 2.4 m is accelerated along a level dock. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 12x + 32 = 0, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. A train of 12 identical dollies is driven at once, and the tow bar also carries 14 kN of static load on top of the combined drive force. What total load, in kN, does the tow bar carry?
w10_P4_000448: A kart-track conveyor accelerates karts of mass 20 kg along a lane 35 m long. Each kart's acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0, and the force producing it is expressed in kN. A lane carries 12 identical karts, and the conveyor runs 2 identical lanes. The conveyor frame also carries 25 kN of static load on top of the combined drive force. What total load, in kN, does the frame carry?
w10_P4_000449: A supermarket stock cart of mass 86 kg is pushed along an aisle 25 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0. The push must supply the force producing that acceleration plus 22 N of wheel friction, plus 8 N from a dragging brush, plus 26 N of ramp resistance. There are 10 identical carts pushed at once. What total push, in N, is applied?
